text:
jem: Short thread to lock final landing copy + launch posts + webinar gating for hosted / dedicated / private. Need: 2 hero variants per mode, one-line pitch, 3 benchmark bullets (sidebar), precise form fields + hidden keys for routing, and CTA verbs. Freeze by tomorrow AM.
rafa: I'll draft hero lines with two different tones (developer-direct and customer-impact). Posting both sets.
li: Ill add microcopy for the lead form and the consult checkbox. Please use explicit placeholder text so dev doesn't have to guess.
nate: Routing ops proposal: hidden key = lead_bucket (values: hosted|dedicated|private), campaign_tag=launch_june_2026, consult_review=true/false. Mapping: lead_bucket==hosted -> assign_queue: hosted_signup; lead_bucket in (dedicated,private) -> assign_queue: enterprise_ops. If est_monthly_tokens > 75_000_000 -> escalate_to: enterprise_sdr. If consult_review == true -> add_tag: wants_review.
marta: Bench plan: three micro-cases with new sample metrics: p95/p99 where relevant + a short method line. I'll produce a single benchmark card graphic with numbers and a link to methodology.
rafa: HERO OPTIONS (developer-direct tone):
HOSTED H1: "Hostless inference, instant API."
HOSTED H2: "Low-latency streaming and straightforward SDKs for engineers."
CTA: "Activate Hosted"

DEDICATED H1: "Provisioned clusters for steady throughput."
DEDICATED H2: "Reserved GPU pools + autoscale rules and SLAs."
CTA: "Claim Dedicated Pool"

PRIVATE H1: "Shielded inference in your network."
PRIVATE H2: "On-prem and VPC options with KMS and audit trails."
CTA: "Schedule Private Review"

jem: nice. now the customer-impact tone.
rafa: HERO OPTIONS (customer-impact tone):
HOSTED H1: "Ship features fast, without managing GPUs."
HOSTED H2: "Predictable performance and pricing from day one."
CTA: "Activate Hosted"

DEDICATED H1: "Throughput that matches production demand."
DEDICATED H2: "Predictable capacity and isolation for mission-critical flows."
CTA: "Claim Dedicated Pool"

PRIVATE H1: "Control and compliance, not compromise."
PRIVATE H2: "Private control plane, audit-ready, deployable on-prem."
CTA: "Schedule Private Review"

li: FORM MICROCOPY (exact):
Visible fields: full_name, email, company (optional, placeholder: "e.g., Acme Corp"), role (dropdown: Engineer, Product, Ops, Other), workload_type (dropdown: Latency-sensitive, Batch/Embeddings, Regulated), est_monthly_tokens (optional, placeholder: "approx. tokens/month"), message (optional)
Checkbox label: "Yes, Id like a technical capacity review and agree to be contacted."
Privacy blurb: "Well use your information to respond to this inquiry. See our privacy policy."
Hidden fields (exact keys): lead_bucket, campaign_tag, consult_review
Micro-CTA under bullets: "View benchmark details" linking to /benchmarks/launch-grid

nate: ROUTING SNIPPET (hand to eng):
POST /api/lead-capture
payload: { full_name, email, company, role, workload_type, est_monthly_tokens, lead_bucket, consult_review, campaign_tag }
rules: if payload.lead_bucket == "hosted" then assign_queue = "hosted_signup"; else assign_queue = "enterprise_ops"; if payload.consult_review == true then add_tag = "wants_review"; if payload.est_monthly_tokens > 75000000 then escalate_to = "enterprise_sdr"
Notes: campaign_tag must be passed as a string exactly "launch_june_2026" for analytics joins.

marta: BENCHMARK SIDEBAR (short bullets and metrics):
- Latency-first: p95=22ms, p99=48ms (seq 256, H100)  good for microservices
- Batch embeddings: 2.9x throughput vs baseline (512 batch windows)  embedding pipelines
- Regulated: validated air-gapped deploys + KMS/HSM integration  compliance-ready
Method note: measurements run on H100 instances, sequence profiles noted in the appendix. Link: /blog/launch-benchmarks#method.

jem: Webinar gating & copy: 30 min talk + 20 Q&A. Benefit one-liner: "Practical serving patterns that cut unit cost while keeping tails tight." Takeaways (bullets): (1) design patterns for low tail latency; (2) batching & cache tactics that reduce token cost; (3) rollout and fallback playbook for safe upgrades. Gate: full benchmark PDF and appendix behind registration; download triggers lead tag if consult checkbox checked.

rafa: Social snippets (fresh wording):
- X short: "Redwood Inference: predictable inference without the ops. Activate Hosted trial today."
- LinkedIn short: "How we benchmarked three production patterns to balance latency and cost. Join the webinar for the full method and PDF. Register -> link."
- X thread opener: "Benchmarked: latency, batch embeddings, and regulated deploys. Thread: " then list three micro-cases + link.

li: UX & email follow-up flow: confirmation page should surface a mini-card with the relevant benchmark bullet for the selected workload_type (e.g., show p95/p99 if latency selected). Post-submit email subject: "Thanks — your benchmark PDF + next steps". If consult_review == true, attach a 1-pager and create a task in SFDC.
nate: SFDC mapping: hosted_signup queue, enterprise_ops queue, enterprise_sdr team. Add Slack alert to #sales-inbound for any lead where consult_review == true and est_monthly_tokens > 50M. Also ensure analytics events: form_submit, consult_checked, benchmark_download.
ops-bot: pages-staging-deploy: scheduled 2026-06-09T18:00Z; social-schedule queued 2026-06-10 09:00 UTC; both on hold pending manual approval.
jem: Final checklist before freeze: 1) copy pushed to staging pages 2) microcopy doc and placeholders in drive 3) webhook snippet in infra repo 4) benchmark card assets added to drive 5) webinar landing gated + registration flow wired 6) social drafts ready in scheduler. Post here when items 1-5 are done and Ill sign off.

jem: tagging @rafa @li @nate @marta for the morning freeze. Thanks team! :rocket:
